items.title: Stryker stock falls on slower peripheral vascular, hip sales
items.summary: Stryker shares fell after the cyberattack on its Microsoft environment (confirmed 04/09) disrupted its peripheral vascular business, acquired last year, and hip sales weakened. Stock down more than 10% in the week following the incident.

items.title: Medtronic Endurant stent graft wins CE-marked labelling change for ruptured AAA
items.summary: Cardiovascular Business reported that Medtronic's Endurant stent graft has CE-marked labelling that no longer carries the warning that it has not been evaluated for ruptured abdominal aortic aneurysms, which could support wider EVAR use in ruptured AAA.

items.title: “Huge variation in practice”: Early insights from the European Venous Registry
items.summary: The European Society for Vascular Surgery (ESVS) European Venous Registry (EVeR) is set to elucidate clinical practice patterns for the management of deep venous disease, with the aim of improving long-term patient outcomes.

items.title: iPerf concludes clinical trial of novel dual-lumen femoral arterial cannula for cardiopulmonary support
items.summary: iPerf has announced the conclusion of its first clinical trial evaluating its dual-lumen femoral arterial cannula for cardiopulmonary support.

items.title: SWEDEPAD 2 sparks guideline update for asymptomatic PAD and intermittent claudication
items.summary: The European Society for Vascular Surgery (ESVS) has incorporated new evidence, predominantly from SWEDEPAD 2, into updated recommendations on the management of asymptomatic peripheral arterial disease (PAD) and intermittent claudication.

items.title: Mölnlycke launches Biogel radiation protection gloves to reduce clinician hand exposure during procedures
items.summary: Mölnlycke Health Care US announced today the launch of a new surgical glove range designed to reduce clinician hand exposure to scattered radiation during fluoroscopy-guided, interventional and other image-dependent procedures.
